why: General Hadwiger conjecture (open for t>=6) remains unresolved; searches surfaced only work on restricted graph classes (independence number 2, co-claw/co-gem-free graphs, strongly regular graphs) and on distinct variants (odd Hadwiger conjecture, dominating Hadwiger conjecture), including a 2025 disproof of the odd-minor variant specifically, none of which settle the stated conjecture itself.

found.title: Disproof of the Odd Hadwiger Conjecture
found.note: Disproves the odd-minor variant of Hadwiger's conjecture, a distinct strengthened statement, not the conjecture as stated.

found.title: Verifying Hadwiger's Conjecture for Examples of Graphs with alpha(G)=2
found.note: Proves conjecture for specific graph classes with independence number 2; restricted-case work, general case still open.

found.title: Dominating Hadwiger's Conjecture holds for all 2K2-free graphs
found.note: Concerns a different strengthened variant (dominating Hadwiger) for a restricted graph class.
